review.question_for_reviewer: 請核對新舊制度的資格、一般間隔與例外資格重疊時的最短公費間隔，並分別核對繁中與美式英文用語。

variants.question: 以 2024 年 12 月 31 日為準，臺灣一位 36 歲、參加全民健保的民眾到診所詢問國健署公費成人預防保健服務。他沒有不適，從未使用這項服務，有確診小兒麻痺的病史，符合該方案的小兒麻痺身分類別。依題示年齡與身分，這項服務最短每隔多久可獲補助？若目前不符合資格，請選對應項目。請說明依據。

options.D: 目前不符合這項服務的補助資格

variants.rationale: 依 2024 年國健署說明，具小兒麻痺身分者自 35 歲起可每年接受一次成人預防保健服務。本例 36 歲，符合這項資格。

historical_basis.locator: 慢性疾病防治組，正文第 2 段，成人預防保健服務對象及年度檢查資格。

clinical_update.question: 以 2026 年 11 月 26 日為準，臺灣一位 36 歲、參加全民健保的民眾到診所詢問國健署公費成人預防保健服務。他沒有不適，從未使用這項服務，有確診小兒麻痺的病史，符合該方案的小兒麻痺身分類別。依題示年齡與身分，這項服務最短每隔多久可獲補助？若目前不符合資格，請選對應項目。請說明依據。
clinical_update.rationale: 選 A。個案已滿 35 歲且具小兒麻痺身分，可每年使用一次。雖然他也在 30 至 39 歲之間，但五年是一般間隔。

claims.text: 30 至 39 歲的一般服務間隔為每 5 年一次。
年滿 35 歲且具小兒麻痺身分者，公費方案可每年提供一次成人預防保健服務。

variants.question: As of December 31, 2024, a 36-year-old adult enrolled in Taiwan’s National Health Insurance asks about the Health Promotion Administration’s publicly funded adult preventive health service. He has no symptoms, has never used this service, and has a documented history of polio that qualifies him for the program’s polio category. At his current age, what is the shortest routine interval covered for someone in his eligibility category? If he is currently ineligible, select that option. Explain your answer.

options.D: Not currently eligible for funding under this program

variants.rationale: Under the 2024 program, a person in the polio category was eligible each year starting at age 35. This 36-year-old met that criterion.

historical_basis.locator: 慢性疾病防治組，正文第 2 段，成人預防保健服務對象及年度檢查資格。

clinical_update.question: As of November 26, 2026, a 36-year-old adult enrolled in Taiwan’s National Health Insurance asks about the Health Promotion Administration’s publicly funded adult preventive health service. He has no symptoms, has never used this service, and has a documented history of polio that qualifies him for the program’s polio category. At his current age, what is the shortest routine interval covered for someone in his eligibility category? If he is currently ineligible, select that option. Explain your answer.
clinical_update.rationale: A. This patient is at least 35 and belongs to the polio category, so he qualifies annually. Five years is the general interval for his age group.

claims.text: The general interval for adults ages 30 through 39 is once every five years.
People in the program’s polio category qualify annually starting at age 35.
